name: XLSX
description: Read, create, and modify Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx) files. Supports reading cell data, creating workbooks with multiple sheets, writing cells, formulas, CSV/TSV conversion, and batch modifications.

tools.description: Read an Excel (.xlsx) file and load it into memory. Returns structured cell data for all or a specific sheet. Use the returned workbook_id to reference this workbook in subsequent tool calls.

path.description: Path to the .xlsx file (relative to workspace or absolute)

sheet_name.description: Read only this sheet (optional, reads all sheets if omitted)

range.description: Read only this cell range, e.g. 'A1:D10' (optional, reads all cells if omitted)

tools.description: Get the value of a specific cell or range from an already-loaded workbook. Use read_xlsx first to load the workbook.

workbook_id.description: Workbook ID from read_xlsx or create_xlsx

tools.description: List all sheet names in an Excel (.xlsx) file without reading all cell data.

path.description: Path to the .xlsx file (relative to workspace or absolute)

tools.description: Describe an Excel (.xlsx) workbook without returning all cell data. Returns sheet names, visibility state, used ranges, row and column counts, formula counts, merged ranges, warnings, and a workbook_id for follow-up calls.

path.description: Path to the .xlsx file (relative to workspace or absolute)

tools.description: Create a new workbook in memory with one or more sheets. Each sheet can have optional headers and rows of data. Values are auto-detected as numbers, booleans, or strings. Use save_xlsx to write the workbook to disk.

rows.description: Data rows (2D array of values as strings)

tools.description: Write or update specific cells in a workbook that is already loaded in memory. If the sheet does not exist, it will be created. Invalid cells are skipped and reported in the errors field of the result. Use save_xlsx afterwards to persist changes to disk.

workbook_id.description: Workbook ID from read_xlsx or create_xlsx

sheet_name.description: Sheet name (created if it doesn't exist)

value.description: Cell value (auto-detected type, or use type parameter)

type.description: Force value type: string, number, boolean, formula

tools.description: Save a workbook from memory to an .xlsx file on disk. The .xlsx extension is added automatically if missing. Existing files require overwrite=true; dry_run=true reports the planned write without modifying disk.

workbook_id.description: Workbook ID from read_xlsx or create_xlsx

path.description: Output file path (relative to workspace or absolute)

overwrite.description: Required to replace an existing file. Defaults to false.

dry_run.description: If true, validate and report the planned save without writing a file.

tools.description: Convert a sheet from an Excel (.xlsx) file to CSV or TSV text. Reads directly from disk.

sheet_name.description: Sheet to export (defaults to first sheet)

tools.description: Import CSV or TSV text data into a new workbook in memory. Use save_xlsx to write to disk afterwards.

has_header.description: If true, first row is treated as headers (kept as strings). Default: false

delimiter.description: Field delimiter: ',' (default), 'tab', or any single character

tools.description: Apply batch modifications to a workbook in memory. Supports setting cells, formulas, deleting rows/columns, renaming sheets, and adding sheets. Invalid operations are skipped and reported in the errors field of the result. Note: delete_row/delete_column shift cell values only; formula references and merged ranges are not adjusted. Use save_xlsx afterwards to persist.

workbook_id.description: Workbook ID from read_xlsx or create_xlsx

sheet_name.description: Target sheet name (required for cell/row/column operations)

type.description: Operation type: set_cell, set_formula, delete_row, delete_column, rename_sheet, add_sheet
